purpose: Source of truth for the host lobby visual implementation. Presentation only; game/network behavior stays unchanged.

style: dark navy UI panels with red/blue team accents
direction.mustFeelLike: The existing White House arena, not a SaaS lobby and not glossy mobile-cartoon art.
doNotUse: independent art direction different from the in-game arena
new politician illustrations when an existing game sprite is available

arena.usage: Render the existing White House sunset decor as the lobby background. Darken only as much as needed for UI readability.

characters.rule: Always render the sprite already configured for the selected character. If character.sprite is a PNG path, use that PNG. Do not redraw the character for the lobby.

background.overlay: subtle dark navy overlay behind UI only; preserve sunset, White House, crowd and cage visibility

brand.title: SHOWER BRAWL
brand.subtitle: THE WHITE HOUSE
brand.treatment: pixel-arcade lockup, white title with restrained red/blue accents

meta.treatment: small pixel/monospace uppercase, low visual priority

joinPanel.title: SCAN TO JOIN
joinPanel.panel: dark navy rectangular arcade frame, square corners or very small radius, thin inner highlight

startButton.label: START MATCH
startButton.treatment: large yellow/gold arcade button with dark outline; strongest CTA on screen

rosterStrip.title: 10 CHARACTERS
rosterStrip.content: Show existing character sprites only as a visual roster/status strip; character choice remains on /play/.

typography.direction: pixel/arcade or blocky monospace; uppercase for headings
typography.fallback: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

preserveBehavior: Do not change join/start/reset game logic.
Do not make the host roster interactive.
Visual work must continue to use live lobby data.

responsive.minimum: Keep QR, both team panels and START visible at 1366x768 without page scrolling.
responsive.fallback: At narrower widths, shrink decorative meta/roster before shrinking QR or player names.

acceptanceCriteria: Lobby immediately looks like the same game as the White House arena.
Existing character sprites are used in occupied team slots.
Blue and red teams are readable from several meters away.
QR code remains large and scannable.
START MATCH is always visible on the primary 16:9 host screen.
No game/network logic is altered by this visual implementation.
